history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration ensure adherence to the newly established process of prioritizing the placement of candidates from unrepresented or underrepresented Member States.
history.administration_response: The recommendation has been implemented. The attached table indicates the candidates selected for the young professional programme after the Administration’s acceptance (in May 2024) of the recommendation contained in paragraph 286 of A/79/5 (Vol. I), published on 24 July 2024. The data show that all external candidates selected are from unrepresented or underrepresented Member States and demonstrate that the referenced practice is now being followed. On the basis of the action taken, the Administration requests the closure of this recommendation by the Board.
history.board_assessment: Given that the recruitment list shows that the external candidates selected in 2024 are from unrepresented or underrepresented Member States, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
